plan_review.notes: Alt A aggregate multi-level gains into one +N floater was rejected to preserve the original per-level feedback requirement. Alt B add stack metadata to the shared floater contract was rejected as extra surface area for a renderer-owned readability concern. Reused the existing main-scene probe floating-text seam instead of adding a new observability surface, made the audit fix explicit by bumping brace-expansion/minimatch overrides and rerunning security:audit, and changed staggering to per-frame position clusters so already-live floaters do not affect new notices.
